blocked_reason: ADB USB transport disappeared during the healthy 1024-token run. Canonical server restart, explicit trusted ADB_VENDOR_KEYS, reconnect, Windows PnP restart/disable-enable, local subnet discovery, TCP/5555 probes, and ADB mDNS discovery did not restore a transport. ADB-over-WiFi had not been enabled before USB disappeared. Recovering device access now requires a physical cable reconnect and possibly accepting the USB-debugging prompt, which the operator explicitly will not perform.
